name: Timeline
summary: An ordered list of events joined by a line, with a dot, an icon or an avatar as each marker.
description: Use it for activity feeds, order history and changelogs, newest first. The compact modifier suits sidebars and release notes. For steps a person still has to complete, use steps.

classes.name: v-timeline-compact
classes.description: Smaller markers, tighter spacing and smaller text.

classes.name: v-timeline-item
classes.description: One event. Draws the joining line to the next item.

classes.name: v-timeline-marker
classes.description: The marker. Leave it empty for a dot, or put an icon or a .v-avatar inside.

classes.name: v-timeline-header
classes.description: Title and time on one line, wrapping when narrow.

classes.name: v-timeline-time
classes.description: When, on a <time datetime>. Tabular figures.

a11y: Use an <ol> so the order is announced and the number of events is known.
Mark the marker aria-hidden="true": the title says what happened, the icon only decorates it.
Put a machine-readable datetime on each <time>, so "Yesterday" still has an exact date.
The line stops short of each marker, so no marker needs an opaque background and Glass stays see-through.
